name: @workspec/site
description: The WorkSpec Studio site — free workbench over your WorkSpec artifacts, modules as paths (/decisions and /c4, each with its own in-browser demo). Consumes the PUBLISHED @workspec/decision-* packages from npm — if the site builds, those packages work for outside consumers. The @workspec/c4-* packages are a temporary workspace-devDependency exception (not yet published) — see docs/c4/drift-log.md.
_LOUD_NOTICE_devDependencies_c4_packages: The four @workspec/c4-* entries in devDependencies below are workspace:* — NOT registry pins like every @workspec/decision-* dependency above. The c4 packages aren't published to npm yet; this is a deliberate, TEMPORARY exception to this app's registry-pins-only rule, scoped ONLY to c4 (the decisions demo's pins are untouched). See docs/c4/drift-log.md entry 17 and this package's README.md. Flip each to a published semver range and move it up into "dependencies" at first publish — a one-line change per package.
